title: Elf Bar Dual 10K Exotic Edition Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Exotic Edition Pre Filled Pods introduce two unusual flavour profiles to the Elf Bar Dual 10K experience. One pod features Glazed Fruit Medley - a sweet, complex blend of syrupy fruit flavours. The second offers Green Lokum, echoing the unique taste of Middle Eastern confectionery with a subtle herbal twist. Both pods include integrated 5ml refill chambers to keep the flavour going longer, powered by the Dual 10K refill system. For adventurous vapers looking to try something different, Exotic Edition is a bold choice. How to Use: 1. Remove the Sticker and Read the Instructions 2. Remove the Silicone Parts and the Bottom Sticker 3. Press both containers securely into place 4. Install the pod into the Dual 10K device to use
